title: Export signature scan
responsibility: Extracts top-level exports, visible class methods and syntactically identifiable error names from source.

inputs.name: scanExports.code
inputs.description: JavaScript/TypeScript source text; comments and literal contents are masked before export and thrown-error pattern scans. Only top-level syntactic export declarations are matched, with visible class methods included.
examples: export function format(value: string): string { return value.trim(); }
export const square = (n: number): number => n * n;

inputs.name: scanSymbolErrors.code
inputs.description: TypeScript source parsed using the latest target; top-level function declarations, function-valued variables, and class methods are mapped by name. Only mapped declaration bodies are inspected, and nested function-like bodies are skipped.
examples: export function read(): string { throw new TypeError('missing'); }

inputs.name: scanSymbolErrors.symbols
inputs.description: Previously discovered symbols matched to declaration bodies by name; matching entries are copied with syntactically identified errors and an errorStatus. Entries without a matching declaration remain unchanged.

outputs.name: scanExports
outputs.description: Returns source-ordered symbols for matched top-level export declarations and visible class methods, with signature inputs and a readable output type when found (unknown otherwise); matching declaration bodies may carry errors and errorStatus from scanSymbolErrors. The separate errors array is sorted and deduplicated and includes names from textual throw new, ExpectedCliError from fail(...), and HttpError N from numeric error(N) calls.
